external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: A deployed sensor node installed on a customer site that publishes readings and polls for firmware images.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway
external_entities.notes: The nodes are outside the system owner's physical control.

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An operator who views telemetry dashboards from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker running on GKE that accepts readings from sensor nodes and forwards them to Pub/Sub.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE and expose to the internet

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer in the analytics network that picks up readings and writes them into the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

processes.name: dashboard
processes.description: A dashboard used by fleet operators to view telemetry over BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry used by the device gateway to check a device key and identify the customer associated with a node.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A Pub/Sub service onto which the device gateway forwards accepted readings before they are picked up by the telemetry normalizer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing readings, site addresses, and occupancy patterns.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.

data_stores.name: Cloud Storage bucket
data_stores.description: A Cloud Storage bucket from which sensor nodes poll for firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image

data_flows.name: sensor node to device gateway readings
data_flows.description: A sensor node publishes readings to the device gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway
data_flows.notes: The pre-shared key is per fleet, not per device, and has not been rotated since deployment.

data_flows.name: device gateway to device registry lookup
data_flows.description: The device gateway looks up a device in the registry to check its key and determine its customer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key

data_flows.name: device gateway to Pub/Sub readings
data_flows.description: The device gateway forwards accepted readings onto Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_flows.name: Pub/Sub to telemetry normalizer readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer picks up readings from Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_flows.name: telemetry normalizer to telemetry lake readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer writes readings into the telemetry lake.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery

data_flows.name: sensor node to Cloud Storage bucket firmware
data_flows.description: A sensor node polls the Cloud Storage bucket for a firmware image.
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_flows.notes: The bucket is public read. The source says: "I do not know whether the nodes check a signature on the image before installing it."

data_flows.name: field technician to sensor node serial console
data_flows.description: A field technician services a sensor node over its local serial console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: I don't know what authentication that console has, if any.

data_flows.name: fleet operator to dashboard view
data_flows.description: A fleet operator views dashboards from the corporate network while signed in with company SSO.
data_flows.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO

data_flows.name: dashboard to telemetry lake query
data_flows.description: The dashboard accesses telemetry over BigQuery for display to fleet operators.

trust_boundaries.name: customer sites

trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: sensor nodes installed on customer sites

trust_boundaries.name: GKE

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake's contents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The lake contains site addresses and occupancy patterns and is described as customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The device registry's key and customer association data are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The registry contains a device key and information about which customer a node belongs to.

assumptions.assumption: The Cloud Storage bucket's firmware image is public in classification.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly says the bucket is public read.

assumptions.assumption: The dashboard presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source names a dashboard used by operators to view data; dashboards are treated as web-facing application interfaces.
